required_inputs.name: corrected_invoice_pdf
required_inputs.description: Final invoice PDF with validated page count, invoice number, total, May 29 completed, and June 5 scheduled.

required_inputs.name: po_number
required_inputs.description: Capital Hilton PO used for PO-based invoice creation.

required_inputs.name: invoice_number_normalized_for_coupa
required_inputs.description: Hilton Coupa rejected special characters, so the hyphen was removed for portal submission.

required_inputs.name: remit_to_selection
required_inputs.description: Operator selected the mailing/check address for Winship, not the bank option.

required_inputs.name: final_submit_approval
required_inputs.description: Operator approval is required before clicking the final Coupa Send Invoice action.

required_inputs.name: post_submit_email_approval
required_inputs.description: Operator approval is required before sending the post-submit email with the corrected PDF.

gates.label: Login/MFA gate
gates.automation_boundary: Automation may resume only after the operator is logged in and the correct Coupa account/customer context is visible.

gates.label: Remit-To selection gate
gates.automation_boundary: Remit-To is a business decision; defaulting is not allowed.

gates.label: Invoice number normalization gate
gates.automation_boundary: If Coupa rejects special characters, preserve workbook/PDF invoice number and separately record portal-normalized invoice number.

gates.label: Final Coupa submit gate
gates.automation_boundary: The final Send Invoice action is blocked until explicit operator approval for that exact invoice.

gates.label: Gmail draft review gate
gates.automation_boundary: Draft body, recipients, CC, subject, and attachment proof must be reviewed before final send.

gates.label: Final email send gate
gates.automation_boundary: Email send is blocked until explicit operator approval.

what_can_be_automated: Validate that the corrected invoice PDF exists, is one page, and matches the expected hash/text facts.
Navigate to Coupa order context after operator login and customer selection.
Find PO DCASH00983536 and start Create Invoice from PO.
Read and verify prefilled supplier, customer, PO line, quantity, price, total, invoice date, and currency.
Calculate and classify Coupa warnings before presenting a final submit packet.
Create or replace a Gmail draft with attachment proof for operator review.
what_requires_operator_confirmation: Remit-To selection, especially mailing/check address versus bank option.
Invoice number normalization when Coupa disallows special characters.
Final Gmail send after draft, CC, body, and attachment review.
what_failed_today: Excel/AppleScript export returned success but produced no PDF.
Excel helper had OPEN_WORKBOOK and permission fragility.
Print-to-PDF UI was the path that actually worked.
openpyxl was missing in the default Python environment.
Browser text helpers hit a virtual clipboard issue.
Gmail draft with attachment needed replacement because attachment drafts were not editable in place.
what_should_be_tested_next: A deterministic workbook reader and patcher path independent of ad hoc Python packages.
Receipt-driven Excel open/export/close with artifact existence, text, and hash validation.
Stable local working-copy roots for client workbook permissions.
Coupa PO invoice state machine with customer select, PO locate, remit-to gate, field recheck, calculate, warning classify, final submit gate, and processing receipt.
Gmail draft replacement and stale-draft warning behavior.

workflow_outline: Prepare and validate corrected invoice PDF.
Operator completes Coupa login/MFA and confirms Hilton | Smart Spend customer context.
Locate PO DCASH00983536 and create invoice from PO.
Verify prefilled line facts and invoice total.
Enter workbook invoice number, normalize for Coupa if required, and record both values.
Pause for final Coupa submit gate.
Record post-submit status as Processing unless Coupa shows another explicit state.
Prepare Gmail draft with corrected PDF, CC behavior as requested, and attachment proof.
Pause for Gmail draft review gate and final email send gate.
Keep ledger and paid state untouched.
